## Executive Summary

Seasoned Senior Quality Engineer and QA Lead with over 19 years of experience delivering end-to-end automation frameworks across web, mobile, and API platforms using Playwright and TypeScript. Expert in integrating automated test suites into Azure DevOps and GitHub CI/CD pipelines, leveraging AI-assisted coding tools like GitHub Copilot for script generation and PR reviews to accelerate software delivery. Proven technical leader skilled in guiding cross-functional teams through complex platform migrations, conducting code reviews, and driving defect triage to enforce rigorous quality standards.
